input: Commission a custom wedding cake tasting

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether the tasting covers just flavors/fillings or also includes design consultation and pricing changes how much to prepare and what to ask the baker.
The number of people attending the tasting (couple only, future in-laws, wedding party) affects how many samples are needed and logistics with the bakery.
Whether a bakery has already been shortlisted or research still needs to be done completely changes the first steps of the plan.
The overall wedding cake budget determines which bakeries are realistic options and how elaborate the tasting can be.
The wedding date sets a hard deadline and determines urgency — tastings are often booked weeks to months in advance.
Dietary requirements or flavor preferences (e.g. gluten-free, vegan, specific fruit or chocolate flavors) narrow down which bakeries to approach and what to request at the tasting.
Understanding what a successful tasting looks like — locking in a contract, settling on flavors, or just exploring options — defines what 'done well' means and what to bring to the appointment.

gold.taskTitle: Commission a Custom Wedding Cake Tasting
gold.taskDescription: Arrange a custom wedding cake tasting session with a baker or bakery to sample flavors, fillings, and designs ahead of ordering the final wedding cake.

questions.title: What should the tasting cover beyond just cake flavors?
questions.description: Clarify whether the session should also include fillings, frostings, design consultation, or contract discussion — this defines the scope of what to request from the bakery.

questions.title: Who will be attending the tasting with you?
questions.description: Identify how many people (partner, family, wedding party) are coming so the right number of samples and seating can be arranged.

questions.title: Do you already have specific bakeries in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether bakery research and shortlisting still needs to happen or if the focus is on booking a tasting with already-identified candidates.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the wedding cake?
questions.description: Establish a budget range so bakery options can be filtered appropriately and expectations for the tasting are realistic.

questions.title: When is your wedding date?
questions.description: The wedding date sets the deadline and determines how urgently the tasting needs to be booked, since popular bakeries fill up months in advance.

questions.title: Are there any dietary requirements or flavor preferences to factor in?
questions.description: Knowing about allergies, intolerances, or strong flavor preferences (vegan, gluten-free, chocolate, citrus, etc.) narrows which bakeries to approach and what to sample.

questions.title: What does a successful tasting look like for you?
questions.description: Clarify the desired outcome — simply exploring options, finalizing flavors, or signing a contract on the day — so the right materials and questions can be prepared in advance.
